thread:
Maya: Quick poll — who remembers the origin of the "Banana Chair" legend? :banana:
Devin: Oh man. Legend goes back to Hack Week 2021 when Kyle brought an inflatable banana chair for demo energy and refused to stand for the entire talk. He became 'Banana King'. :joy:
Sasha: Confirmed. He also dared anyone to code with their feet on that thing. I still have a photo.
Jamie: Photo? post it pls :eyes: 
Devin: uploading... (attaches 1 image) [kyle_banana.jpg]
Carlos: The lore part: after the deploy that mysteriously fixed itself, someone left a sticky note 'Banana Contract fulfilled' on the helm dashboard. It stuck.
Aria: That sticky note is how we started using banana emoji to mark 'temporary but working' fixes :banana:✨
Maya: Also, shoutout to Sir Photos (Kyle's desk plant) who survived three office moves and a power outage — true Redwood hero.
Sasha: We should make a sticker pack: Banana Chair, Sir Photos, 'Banana Contract' sticky note.
Jamie: Design vote: classic yellow or retro 8-bit banana? I'm team 8-bit.
Carlos: 8-bit + tiny crown for Banana King.
Maya: Poll: sticker theme? React with :one: Classic yellow, :two: 8-bit crown, :three: Minimal outline.
Aria: Also who wants a Banana Chair lore reading at company retro? We'll do a 2-min origin story.
Devin: I'll MC. Costume optional but encouraged.
OpsBot: reminder: redwood-ops-policy requires chairs to be approved by facilities if inflatable. See /docs/facilities.
Maya: facilities approval noted :ok_hand: Thanks OpsBot.
Sasha: This thread is peak Redwood culture. :clap: 
Jamie: Vote counts incoming...
Maya: (after poll) Results: :two: wins. 8-bit crown it is. Sticker kickoff next week. :tada: 
Devin: I'm making the sprite sheet.
Carlos: Legend preserved.
